data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 302.5m (2018: GBP 193.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 8.4m (2018: improvement of GBP 9.6m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability, Accident and Health Energy and Marine classes with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Deterioration to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability, Accident and Health, Energy and Marine classes, with partially offsetting favourable developments across other classes.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 was GBP 510.238m. Using the gross claims development triangle, the re-estimation of prior years (2017 and earlier) shows an adverse movement (strengthening) of approximately GBP 22.179m (c. 4.35% of opening reserves), driven by adverse development predominantly in Property, Third party liability (Casualty), Accident & Health, Energy and Marine business. The managing agent's narrative also reports a net deterioration of GBP 8.4m in prior-year reserves (net of reinsurance). RITC activity and reinsurance flows are noted in the accounts and may influence comparatives.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 302.5m (2018: GBP 193.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 8.4m (2018: improvement of GBP 9.6m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability, Accident and Health Energy and Marine classes with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.
Historic development includes a mix of prior year releases and deteriorations, and in 2019 gross and net deteriorations occurred.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding) 2018 comparative. Prior-year development derived from gross claims development triangle (gross ultimate change for 2017 column = +GBP 22.179m). The narrative reports a net deterioration of GBP 8.4m (net of reinsurance) which differs from the gross triangle-based amount; RITC adjustments and novation activities in 2019 may distort comparisons. Confidence downgraded to 0.8 for prior-year development because triangle-based calculation excludes potential RITC distortions and the report contains net/GROSS mixed presentations.
